usedFor: Shopify holds orders and products, and Seven Time turns an event into a task through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Create Task” in Seven Time
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order leaves follow-up work, and the action creates a task for it.

watchOut: Tasks built from “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify wait for a scheduled check, since that trigger is polling.
